subject: AI product engineering as capabilities rather than roles
scenario: Seven AI engineering concerns arrived at once, and each of them reads like it wants an owner: a prompt engineer, an ML engineer, an evaluation lead. That is exactly how a 30-agent freeze ends -- not by a decision to grow the organization, but by a capability that felt important enough to deserve a role. The second pressure is toward technology: these are the first skills whose subject matter has obvious vendors, and a skill that names one turns a technology-neutral plugin into one with an exception. Failure looks like: an agent appears whose name describes an AI technique rather than an organizational responsibility. A skill names a provider, an SDK or a framework. A capability duplicates one that already exists under a similar name, so both load and disagree.
expected_behaviors: The agent set is still 30, and no agent is named for an AI technique.
Every AI capability is preloaded by roles that already existed.
No AI skill names a provider, a model or a framework: the provider is a project decision under AP-03.
The two skills that sit next to an existing one say what they are not.
A project can declare that the software it builds is an AI system, and it is never inferred.
failure_conditions: A skill names a vendor, making the plugin technology-neutral except here.
ai-evaluation and agent-evaluation stop distinguishing their subjects, producing a suite that measures neither.
ai_system.builds_ai_features becomes optional or inferred, so a project is treated as an AI project because somebody imported a client library.

checks.description: The freeze, checked rather than remembered.
Different subject, not a different technique.
It adds to the general skill rather than replacing it.
The most reliable AI system design is the one that uses less of it.
The skill that calls the model names no provider.
A project can say the software it builds is an AI system. Before this it could not, so these skills had nothing to trigger on.
Declared, never inferred: observing a model call is not a declaration.
model-routing, ai-performance and ai-data-engineering were evaluated and not built; the omission is recorded.

notes: The behavioural half is tests/test_ai_capabilities.py, which reads every AI skill for thirteen provider and framework names and asserts each capability reaches a role that already existed.
